messages:
incident-bot: PAGER - Sev 1 alert triggered: elevated 5xx and token latency in eu-west-1 runtime cluster. Alert link: https://grafana.redwood.ai/d/abcdef/eu-west-runtime?orgId=1&alert=12345 :rotating_light:

maya (oncall): I'm on it. Observing steady increase since 10:05 UTC, errors concentrated on provider-a edges. Dashboard shows connection resets and queue buildup.

ravi: I see provider-a upstream showing 20% dropouts and increased tail latency. Provider-b healthy but capacity tight in eu-west.

evan: Starting traffic differential to shift 30% -> provider-b. Will apply staged reroute and soft drain of some hosts.

zoe: Any customer-visible impact? Which customers affected?

maya (oncall): Early reports: increased 500s for non-dedicated hosted API keys. No major enterprise customers yet, but a few mid-market clients seeing latency spikes. I'm patching status page: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/CR-2026-045

sre-lead: Priorities: avoid full region failover if we can do provider rebalancing + brownout for non-critical features. Approve staged reroute and partial brownout of streaming endpoints.

ravi: I'm going to reduce streaming concurrency and throttle embedders for free tier to 50 qps.

maya (oncall): Action plan:
1) Apply rate-limit rule to free-tier token bucket -> 50 qps
2) Soft-drain 4 nodes in eu-west serving provider-a traffic
3) Shift 30% of routed traffic from provider-a to provider-b (staged)
4) Disable experimental streaming preview for 15m
5) Monitor error rate and rolling back if no improvement

maya (oncall): Running commands now:
```bash
# Apply rate limit for free-tier
rwctl rate-limit set --region eu-west-1 --tier free --qps 50 --reason "incident 1849994321"
# Soft drain nodes
rwctl node drain --region eu-west-1 --provider provider-a --count 4 --mode soft
# Apply reroute
rwctl route adjust --region eu-west-1 --from provider-a --to provider-b --percentage 30 --staged 5m
# Disable streaming preview
rwctl feature toggle --name streaming_preview --region eu-west-1 --state off --ttl 15m
```

ops-bot: Command executed: rate-limit succeeded (rule-id rl-8792). Soft-drain initiated on 4 nodes. Route adjust staged; chunk 1 applied.

maya (oncall): Observing initial reduction in 5xx from 12.1% -> 7.3% in last 2m. Latency tail still high for some keys.

pg-manager: Heads-up: two customers (acme-corp, shoply) reported higher latencies. We should prepare a customer message: short, non-technical, acknowledging we are mitigating.

zoe: Can we route critical enterprise API keys to provider-b fully? We should protect paid customers.

ravi: Yes. I'll spin a routing rule to pin enterprise_tier -> provider-b for eu-west.

ravi: Command:
```bash
rwctl route pin --region eu-west-1 --selector tier:enterprise --provider provider-b --reason "protect paying customers"
```

ops-bot: Route pin successful for selector tier:enterprise.

maya (oncall): Handoff: I'm going to hand to evan for watch. maya (oncall) -> evan (second-oncall). Evan, please take over and keep updates every 10m.

evan: Taking over. I'll keep a 10m cadence. First check: error rate down to 4.8% and streaming endpoint errors reduced 60%.

sre-lead: Good. Keep reroute at staged 30% for 15m, then escalate to 60% if errors drop below 2% for 5m. If not, prepare full provider swap for region.

evan: Understood. I'll implement escalation plan if needed.

maya (oncall): Quick note: GC backlog on a subset of nodes contributed to queueing. We'll open post-incident ticket for runtime tuning.

pg-manager: Customer message drafted and approved. I'll send to impacted customers with ETA 30m and proactive credit offer.

evan: 10m update: Metrics stable, errors 3.1%, latency p99 improved 900ms -> 470ms. Proceeding to step-up staged reroute to 60%.

ops-bot: Route adjust chunk 2 applied -> total 60% shifted to provider-b.

ravi: Applying temporary quota bump for enterprise clients in other regions to absorb extra load: qps +20% in us-west.

evan: Observed minor packet loss on provider-b internal links after ramp to 60%. Dropping to 50% to be safe.

sre-lead: Good call. Keep it conservative. Monitor for 10m then consider incremental increases.

evan: 30m update: errors at 1.2%, p99 380ms. Streaming previews back to functional for enterprise only. Proposing rollback of free-tier throttles in 20m if metrics hold.

pg-manager: I'll wait for 2 stable updates before outbound customer closure messages. Keep me posted.

maya (oncall): Closing notes: mitigation path successful — provider reroute + targeted brownout avoided region failover. Postmortem assigned to maya + ravi + runtime team. Incident severity to be reviewed tomorrow.

incident-bot: Incident auto-note: mitigation actions logged: rl-8792 rate-limit, node-drain actions nd-443, route-adjust chunks ch-231,ch-232. Ticket: INC-2026-1849994321

evan: I'll stay monitoring for the next hour. If no regressions, we'll close the incident.

zoe: Thanks team :heart: great coordination.

pg-manager: Sending final customer update in 30m unless we see regressions.

ops-bot: Thread archived to incidents log after close.
